hero.title: About Demo Solution
hero.body: Demo Solution is a decontamination, demolition and environmental services company serving residential and commercial clients with a clear, practical and safety-focused approach.
hero.imageAlt: Demo Solution — decontamination and environmental services
hero.caption: Demo Solution — decontamination and environmental services

sections.heading: Vision and experience
sections.body: Demo Solution supports property owners, businesses and project managers with a practical, attentive approach focused on clear communication, safe methods and useful decision-making before work starts.

sections.heading: Insurance and compliance
sections.body: Demo Solution carries $2 million in liability coverage and pollution insurance, which adds another level of confidence when hazardous materials, contaminated areas or controlled demolition work are involved.

sections.heading: Service area
sections.body: Demo Solution serves Gatineau and Ottawa depending on the type of file. This regional coverage is useful for decontamination, vermiculite removal, sampling, mould remediation and selective demolition.

sections.heading: Company mission
sections.body: The mission is simple: help clients understand the actual condition of the site, prioritize the right work and move forward with a clean, structured and compliant intervention plan.
